name: Grand Cube Open 2017

venue.name: The Grand Mall
venue.address: 137, Seetharam Nagar Main Road, Velachery, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600042

information: All competitors must be aware of WCA regulations. Online Registration ends on 23rd November, 2017. On the Spot Registration will be available between 9:30-10:00 AM. Please visit Registration Details Tab for details. If you are interested in becoming a full time volunteer for the event, please contact the organizer or delegate. Registration fee for volunteers is capped to INR 200. 15 volunteers will be chosen based on experience and first come first serve basis.
